pages.title: Electrolytic Cell
pages.text: Two electrodes in a conducting liquid: drive a current through it and it comes apart into what it was made of.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Pulls molecules apart with current: electrides, ionic liquids and superacids.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 2 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Aluminium Ingot, Antihydrogen, Carborane Superacid, Caustic Soda, Chlorine, Deuterium, Electride Crystal, Empty Containment Cell, Heavy Water, Hydrogen, Ionic Liquid, Liquid Sodium, Lithium Ingot, Molecular Cloud...
